title: UPLC-MS/MS Procedures for Lipidomics in Plasma Samples
author: Chunwei Zeng
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.imncc5e

steps.title: Thaw Plasma Samples
steps.instruction: Thaw samples by leaving them at -20°C for 30 min and then at 4°C until no ice is observed in the tubes.

steps.title: Perform Protein Precipitation
steps.instruction: Extract lipids from plasma using isopropanol (IPA).

substeps.instruction: Transfer 40 μL of plasma per sample into a new 96-well plate using a multichannel adjustable spacer manual pipette.
Add 120 μL of precooled IPA to each well.
Vortex the 96-well plate for 1 min.
Incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Store the mixture overnight in a refrigerator at -20°C to improve protein precipitation.

steps.title: Separate Supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples for 20 min at 14,000 g.

steps.title: Dilute Supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new 96-well plate and dilute with IPA/acetonitrile (ACN)/H2O (2:1:1 v:v:v).

steps.title: Prepare QC Sample
steps.instruction: Pool equal amounts of all samples to create a QC sample for LC-MS system conditioning and quality control.

steps.title: Equilibrate CSH Column
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the CSH column with 99% Phase B at a flow rate of 0.4 mL/min.

steps.title: Execute LC Gradient Elution
steps.instruction: Run the elution gradient according to the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: Start at 40% B; increase linearly to 43% B over the first 2 min.
Increase to 50% B within 0.1 min.
Increase to 54% B over the next 3.9 min.
Increase to 70% B during the next 0.1 min.
Increase to 99% B and maintain for 1.9 min.
Return to 40% B over 0.1 min and equilibrate for 1.9 min before the next injection.

steps.title: Calibrate Mass Spectrometer
steps.instruction: Perform mass calibration and lock mass measurement.

substeps.instruction: Use sodium formate solution for mass calibration.
Use Leucine enkephalin (MW=555.62) as a lock mass for accurate mass measurements.

steps.title: Configure MS Acquisition Parameters
steps.instruction: Set the MS to operate in both positive and negative modes using Centroid MS E mode.

substeps.instruction: Set acquisition time to 0.2 s per scan.
Set scan range to 50–1,800 Da.
Set capillary voltage to 0.25 kV (positive mode) and 2 kV (negative mode).
Set sampling cone voltages to 40 V for both modes.
Set source temperature to 120°C.
Set desolvation temperature to 500°C and gas flow to 800 L/h.

steps.title: Run Samples and QC
steps.instruction: Analyze samples and QC samples to evaluate system performance.

substeps.instruction: Run 10 QC samples to evaluate the LC-MS system.
Run samples interspersed with QC in positive mode.
Run all samples in negative mode.

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Verify the reproducibility of QC samples and analyze the resulting data using Progenesis QI and metaX.
